digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) system and numbering scheme
propositions: ADR file corpus has 91 files but only 69 distinct numbers; 22 files share 17 duplicate numbers across collision groups (5x0037, 3x0007, 3x0035, and 9 other doubled numbers)
Per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN prevent future collisions by creating add/add git conflicts when two ADRs claim the same number, making the mechanism race-free
Duplicate ADRs are resolved by keeping earliest-landed ADR at its original number and renumbering 22 movers to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order
Cross-references to moved ADRs across docs/ and src/ must be rewritten to their new numbers; slug-bearing references are rewritten deterministically while bare numbers are recorded as UNRESOLVED
CI gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py enforces bijection between ADRs and markers, unique marker content, and validates that all adr/NNNN-slug links in docs/ resolve to existing files
